headline: My Bathroom Remodel: How Long Will It Really Take?
articleBody: If you're wondering how long your bathroom remodel will leave your bathroom out of service, you're not alone! For a standard single bathroom, you can typically expect the on-site construction work to span about 3 to 5 weeks. This usually breaks down with demolition and rough-ins taking the first 1-2 weeks, followed by waterproofing and tiling in weeks 2-3, and then fixtures and finishes in weeks 3-4. However, that's just the construction. The pre-construction phase—designing your space, selecting materials, and getting those all-important permits—often adds several weeks before any physical work begins. Material lead times can be a real factor here, so ordering early is a smart move. When you work with a professional, they'll help coordinate all the trades involved, from plumbers and electricians to tilers, to keep your project moving efficiently and minimize the time your bathroom is out of commission.
